views.name: target_page_visits
views.body_sql: SELECT session AS session_id, path AS page_path, stamp AS visit_timestamp FROM activity_log WHERE path IN ('/regist/input', '/regist/confirm')
views.description: Filter visit records to only include the two target registration pages, retaining session identifier, page path, and visit timestamp.

views.name: valid_sequence_sessions
views.body_sql:
SELECT i.session_id
FROM (
    SELECT session_id, MIN(visit_timestamp) AS min_ts
    FROM target_page_visits
    WHERE page_path = '/search_input/'
    GROUP BY session_id
) i
JOIN (
    SELECT session_id, MIN(visit_timestamp) AS min_ts
    FROM target_page_visits
    WHERE page_path = '/search_list/'
    GROUP BY session_id
) c ON i.session_id = c.session_id
WHERE i.min_ts < c.min_ts
views.description: Aggregate visits per session to determine the earliest occurrence of each target page, then retain only sessions where the input page visit strictly precedes the confirm page visit.
